summary: Reitar Logtech Holdings Ltd (NASDAQ: RITR) filed a Form 6-K announcing the public filing of a Form F-1 registration statement by its controlled subsidiary KLA-iBotics Holdings Limited for a proposed initial public offering of 6,250,000 Class A ordinary shares at an estimated price range of US$4.00 to US$6.00 per share. The IPO is part of Reitar's 'M&A, Integration and Spin-off' (MIS) strategy, following the acquisition of Jingxing Holdings Limited. Reitar retains voting control through Class B shares (20 votes each) held indirectly. The spin-off aims to unlock value and allow KLA to operate as a standalone public company. Watch for SEC review, final IPO pricing, and terms of the dual-class structure as key risk-arb milestones.
